negative_results: At an avoided crossing the branches repel by exactly 2|g| and never touch; a branch hop is a tracking error, not a new mode.
A peak outside the search window / below the quality floor is a lock loss, not a signal.
The tracked trajectory is a SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION over a synthetic spectrum; nothing is measured.
reopening_test: Re-run tests/v8/test_mode_tracker.py; reopen if the avoided-crossing minimum gap stops equalling 2|g|, or a lock loss is no longer detected when the peak leaves the window.

claims.statement: A real-time tracker follows a synthetic mode and stays on the correct adiabatic branch through an avoided crossing.
